summary: Add reviewed plugin marketplace trust metadata, exact-artifact tenant consent, privilege-escalation disclosure and append-only artifact/publisher/installation revocation while reusing the existing Task-025/029 execution boundary.

impacts.evidence: Private plugin versions, installation consents and installation revocations are organization/workspace scoped with explicit composite keys and FORCE RLS. A private listing is accepted only for the exact owner tenant.

Marketplace listings contain publisher/trust/license/requested-authority metadata only. Credentials, secret values, private signing keys and raw provider payloads are forbidden; only secret class names are disclosed for consent.

Existing GET /plugins is additively typed as a marketplace listing page and OpenAPI advances from 0.7.0 to 0.7.1. Operation inventory stays at 30 and existing operation identifiers/paths are unchanged.
Task 078 adds no EventBus type and changes no envelope/event catalog entry.

Connector SDK v1 root interfaces and capability vocabulary are unchanged. Marketplace governance composes the existing signed Task-025 Descriptor/PermissionGrant and inert AdmissionPlan instead of adding a runtime API.

Migration 000028 adds immutable public/private listing, exact-artifact consent and global/tenant revocation evidence. Tenant tables use composite workspace foreign keys and forced RLS; no existing row is rewritten.

Admission is fail-closed across review evidence, explicit tenant consent, artifact/key/installation revocation, then Task-025 SHA-256/Ed25519/request-vs-grant verification before Task-029 sandbox creation. Official/verified listings require SBOM/provenance evidence.

A new version/digest never inherits an old installation grant. Update assessment explicitly identifies capability, secret, network and resource-ceiling escalation plus publisher identity change/trust downgrade; fresh consent is required even without escalation.

Listings, consents and revocations are immutable evidence keyed by publisher identity, exact digest/version and tenant consent. Revocation appends history instead of mutating/deleting prior marketplace decisions.
No synchronization/reconciliation algorithm changes. Exact-artifact identity prevents update ambiguity but does not alter Task-013/014 semantics.

Requested outbound authority is visible as exact TLS host/port destinations and any newly requested destination is an explicit update escalation. Task-029 remains the DNS-rebinding/egress enforcement boundary.
Marketplace listing exposes bounded isolation ceilings and update assessment flags increases; operational runtime measurements remain Task-029/066 concerns.

The migration is additive and governance evidence is append-only. Rollback can stop new marketplace admission without invalidating existing connector data; security revocation evidence must not be rolled back or deleted.

Tests cover visible trust/requested authority, required verified review evidence, exact-digest reconsent, capability escalation, cryptographic tamper rejection, three revocation scopes, private-tenant isolation, migration RLS/append-only constraints and unchanged SDK operation inventory.
